cloud.title: Cloud
cloud.heading: What are you playing today?
cloud.xbox.text: Game Pass games, instantly. The first time, sign in with your Microsoft account.
cloud.ps.text: Play your PS5 from here. The first time, link it to your PlayStation account.
cloud.ps.busy: Getting it ready… (downloads the first time)
cloud.foot: To get back to the console from a cloud game: hold LB + RB + View (or L1 + R1 + SHARE), or press the PS button.
